result.topic_en: Hilbert asks whether a function exists that is continuous and single-valued everywhere in a space constructed by gluing along cut surfaces, and takes as the simplest example 3-dimensional space containing a closed curve with a simple knot, regarded as a branching locus of period 2, which must be cut to make the space simply connected.
